summary: The gyomu_concept source directory organizes core application logic into specialized modules for directory concept construction, document generation, error handling, LLM context management, package analysis, and README generation.
responsibilities: Manages directory concept construction and build result structures.
Coordinates document initialization, modeling, building, translation, and rendering.
Defines domain-specific error classes and phase classifications.
Generates and renders structured LLM context files and thematic sections.
Performs package analysis, path resolution, and dependency collection.
Generates project README files through context initialization and rendering.
relationships: The document generation, LLM context management, package analysis, and README generation components use foundational directory concepts, error handling, and internal utilities.
design_decisions: Modular organization of core domain concepts into specialized packages for directory handling, document generation, error classification, LLM context management, package analysis, and README generation.
